title: Real-Time Stock Market Trend Prediction Using RNN Framework
doi: Real-Time Stock Market Trend Prediction Using RNN Framework | IEEE Conference Publication
proposed_solution: The solution is an LSTM based RNN model that learns temporal patterns from historical OHLC(Open, High, Low, Close) and trading volume data to improve short term stock market forcasting accuracy.
limitation: Reliance on historical OHLCV data makes the model sensitive to external factors such as political events, global crises, unexpected news and sudden market changes.
suggestion: Develop an adaptive hybrid LSTM model that integrates real time event information and periodically retrains to respond to changing market conditions.

title: Stock Price Prediction Using Hybrid Ensemble Learning with Financial News Sentiment and Market Factors
proposed_solution: Hybrid weighted ensemble combininb ARIMA, LSTM, SVR and Random Forest with financial news sentiment and company event data for stock price prediction.
limitation: Limited external sentiment data, fixed ensemble weights, and evaluation on a limited stock/dataset reduce the model's adaptability and generalisability.
suggestion: Train and validate on larger multi stock, multi sector and intraday datasets, and use dynamic ensemble weighting based on market conditions.

title: Exploratory Data Analysis and Machine Learning-based Predictive Modeling for Stock Market Forecasting
proposed_solution: An EDA based stock forecasting framework using feature engineering and Linear Regression, Random Forest, and LSTM models, along with feature-importance analysis and anomaly detection. LSTM achieved the best R² of 94.7%.
limitation: The framework mainly relies on historical and technical data, uses a limited set of prediction models, and employs a simple threshold-based anomaly detection method, limiting adaptability to external events and changing market conditions.
suggestion: Implement adaptive anomaly detection using dynamic thresholds or advanced anomaly detection models.

title: Stock Prediction based on Annual Reports using Large Language Model
proposed_solution: An LLM + CNN multimodal framework that combines annual-report information with historical technical data while dynamically modeling the temporal decay of fundamental information.
limitation: Reliance on annual reports omits higher-frequency information such as quarterly earnings, management guidance and analyst revisions. Evaluation on specific firms and periods also limits generalizability across different markets and conditions.
suggestion: Integrate quarterly earnings, management guidance, analyst reports and earnings calls.

title: Stock Market Trend Prediction Using ML Models
proposed_solution: Hybrid LSTM–Transformer model that combines LSTM's sequential learning with Transformer self-attention to capture both short-term and long-term dependencies in stock-market data.
limitation: The model relies mainly on historical/technical data, has limited cross-market validation, and shows increasing RMSE and training cost as the dataset size increases.
suggestion: Validate across diverse markets, sectors, and market regimes using out-of-sample testing.

title: Explainable AI in Predicting Stock Market Trends
proposed_solution: An XAI-based stock prediction framework that combines LSTM, Transformer, and Random Forest models with SHAP and LIME to provide accurate and interpretable stock-market trend predictions.
limitation: High computational overhead, instability/approximation in post-hoc explanations, and limited adaptability to rapidly changing real-time market conditions.
suggestion: Use faster XAI methods such as TreeSHAP, DeepSHAP or attention-based explanations.

title: Stock Price Movement of Reliance using ML Models
proposed_solution: Uses Machine Learning models to predict whether Reliance stock will go up or down. It uses past stock prices and technical indicators like RSI, MACD, and SMA. Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost are tested and compared.
limitation: The study uses only Reliance stock and mainly depends on past price data and technical indicators. It does not consider news, investor sentiment, or economic factors. The prediction accuracy is also low, with the best result being only 52.77%.
suggestion: Test the model on more Nifty50 stocks and use advanced models like LSTM or GRU to better understand stock price patterns.

title: Optimizing LSTM for Real-Time Stock Price Prediction
proposed_solution: Using LSTM with ATR and Supertrend indicators to predict stock prices and give buy/sell signals. It also provides real-time updates and an interactive dashboard. The LSTM model achieved 72% directional accuracy and performed better than Moving Average and Linear Regression models.
limitation: The model depends heavily on the quality and amount of historical data. It may overfit when stock prices are highly volatile. It also performs poorly during sudden events such as market crashes because past data cannot predict unexpected changes.
suggestion: Test the model on more stocks and different market conditions to check whether it works reliably in real-world trading.

title: Stock Price Prediction Using Time Series Forecasting Model Used HDFC Banking Dataset
proposed_solution: Hybrid LSTM-XGBoost model for stock price prediction. LSTM learns patterns over time, while XGBoost handles complex relationships in the data. The system also uses technical indicators such as moving averages, MACD, and Bollinger Bands to improve predictions.
limitation: The study focuses only on HDFC Bank, so the results may not work for other stocks or markets. Also, it mainly uses historical stock data and does not include news, market sentiment, or economic factors that can affect stock prices.
suggestion: Test the model on different stocks and markets to check if it works well in other situations.

title: Integrating Hybrid Machine Learning Models for Reliable Stock Market Prediction
proposed_solution: Use ML/DL models—Linear Regression, Random Forest, MLP, and LSTM—for next-day FTSE 100 prediction, supported by preprocessing, visualization, and a web-based prediction interface.
limitation: LSTM and MLP performed poorly due to limited data and insufficient tuning. The system relies mainly on historical prices and lacks external factors such as news, sentiment, and macroeconomic indicators.
suggestion: Explore Transformer and hybrid ensemble models, incorporate sentiment/news data, increase dataset size, optimize hyperparameters, and evaluate trading performance using financial metrics.

title: A Feature Enriched LSTM Model for Multiday Stock Market Prediction
proposed_solution: Combination different machine learning models with LSTM. The ML models extract useful features, while LSTM learns time-based patterns to predict future stock prices more accurately.
limitation: The study uses data from only three companies between 2015 and 2018. It does not consider news, investor sentiment, economic factors, or actual trading performance.
suggestion: Use recent data from more companies and markets. Add news, market sentiment, and economic factors. Also, test the model using real trading strategies to check its practical performance.

title: Analysing the Predictive Accuracy of Machine Learning Models in Stock Price Forecasting
proposed_solution: The study compares Linear Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost for next-day stock prediction. It finds Linear Regression gives the best results using basic price and lag features.
limitation: The study uses only TCS stock and limited price-based features.
suggestion: Test more stocks and sectors.

title: Stock Trend Prediction Using Explainable AI
proposed_solution: Using Linear Regression and LSTM with RSI, MACD, and EMA indicators. SHAP is used to explain feature importance, while a Streamlit dashboard helps users understand and compare predictions.
limitation: The study mainly uses AAPL stock data from 2015–2024 and uses only three technical indicators.
suggestion: Use Transformer-based models to study long-term dependencies.

title: Predictive Analytics of the Indian Stock Market Using Machine Learning and Big Data
proposed_solution: The paper compares ARIMA, SVM, LSTM, BiLSTM, CNN-LSTM, and ResNLS for Indian stock prediction. It proposes choosing models based on each stock’s behavior, as different models perform better for different stocks.
limitation: The study covers only four Indian stocks and mainly uses historical price data.
suggestion: Add technical indicators, sentiment data, and better validation methods

title: Stock Price Prediction Using Tensorflow
proposed_solution: Using a Recurrent Neural Network with LSTM units, developed using TensorFlow and Keras. Historical stock data is collected from Yahoo Finance using Python. The model learns sequential patterns from past prices and predicts future stock movements. It also evaluates predictions using profit-based metrics.
limitation: The model has an average prediction error of around $20 between predicted and actual stock prices. The error can change depending on the stock being studied because higher-priced stocks may naturally have larger absolute errors. The paper also mainly evaluates the system using historical Yahoo Finance data.
suggestion: Test the LSTM model on more stocks and different price ranges to better understand how prediction accuracy and error change across different stocks and market conditions.

title: Stock Market Analysis and Price Prediction
proposed_solution: Uses machine-learning techniques to analyze historical stock-market data and identify patterns for predicting future stock prices
limitation: he system mainly depends on historical data, so it may not predict sudden changes caused by political events, economic crises, or natural disasters. Using logistic regression, KNN, and LSTM also increases computational complexity. The model may overfit historical data and does not fully consider macroeconomic factors or global market trends.
suggestion: Develop an adaptive hybrid model using real-time market data, technical indicators, sentiment and macroeconomic factors.

title: Enhancing the Performance of Indian Stock Price using Neural Network Based Regression
proposed_solution: Uses neural-network-based regression to learn relationships between historical Indian stock-market variables and future stock prices.
limitation: Neural networks require sufficient high-quality data and may overfit particular stocks or market periods
suggestion: Use regularization, larger multi-sector datasets and hybrid neural networks with attention mechanisms.

title: Predictive Analysis of Stock Market Data Using Optimal SVM-BAT Algorithm
proposed_solution: Combines Support Vector Machine with Bat Algorithm optimization to optimize parameters and improve stock-market prediction.
limitation: Optimization increases computational complexity and model performance depends on parameter selection.
suggestion: Use adaptive optimization and compare SVM-BAT with XGBoost, LSTM and Transformer-based models

title: Comparison of Different Machine Learning Algorithms for Stock Price Prediction
proposed_solution: Compares multiple machine-learning algorithms to determine their effectiveness in predicting stock prices
limitation: Results can depend on the selected dataset, stocks, features and market period, limiting generalization.
suggestion: Use larger multi-market datasets, walk-forward validation and ensemble/stacking models.

title: Predictive Analytics for Stock Market Price Using LSTM Model
proposed_solution: Uses an LSTM model to learn temporal dependencies in historical stock-price data for forecasting future prices.
limitation: LSTM may struggle with sudden volatility and unexpected market events.
suggestion: Combine LSTM with attention/Transformer models and real-time sentiment and economic indicators

title: Evaluating Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models for Accurate Stock Price Prediction
proposed_solution: Uses machine-learning and deep-learning models to learn complex patterns from historical stock-market data and improve prediction accuracy
limitation: Deep models require high computational resources and may overfit limited datasets
suggestion: Develop an explainable hybrid ensemble and validate it across different stocks and market conditions.

title: Prediction of Indian Stock Market using SVR based using Machine Learning
proposed_solution: Uses Support Vector Regression to predict Indian stock-market values from historical market features.
limitation: SVR performance is sensitive to kernel and hyperparameter selection and may not handle extreme volatility well.
suggestion: Apply automated hyperparameter optimization and combine SVR with deep-learning and sentiment features.

title: Advanced Stock Prediction with Amazon Cloud
proposed_solution: Uses cloud-based infrastructure to support scalable stock-price prediction and machine-learning processing.
limitation: Cloud dependency can introduce computational cost, latency and infrastructure-related limitations.
suggestion: Implement real-time cloud prediction with streaming data, adaptive learning and cost-efficient deployment

title: Predicting Stock Price Using Linear Regression: A Machine Learning Approach
proposed_solution: Uses Linear Regression with Open, High, Low, Close and Volume features to predict future stock prices.
limitation: Linear Regression assumes relatively simple relationships and cannot capture complex nonlinear market behaviour
suggestion: Combine regression with nonlinear models such as Random Forest, XGBoost and LSTM and include sentiment/macroeconomic features

title: Predicting Stock Market Trends Using Machine Learning and Sentiment Analysis
proposed_solution: Combines machine-learning models with financial-news/social-media sentiment and traditional stock indicators to predict market trends.
limitation: Sentiment extraction can be noisy, ambiguous and affected by delays or incorrect classification.
suggestion: Use financial-domain Transformer models such as FinBERT/BERT and integrate real-time multi-source sentiment with market data.

title: Intraday Stock Price Prediction using Machine Learning: A Case Study on YFinance Stock Data
proposed_solution: Uses machine-learning techniques on YFinance intraday stock data to forecast short-term price movements.
limitation: Intraday prices are highly volatile and a single data source may limit generalization.
suggestion: Use multiple real-time data sources, high-frequency features and online/adaptive learning.

title: Stock Price Prediction Using Enhanced LSTM Models and Technical Indicators
proposed_solution: Enhances LSTM-based prediction by incorporating technical indicators with historical stock-price data
limitation: Technical indicators are derived mainly from historical prices and may be less effective during unexpected events.
suggestion: Integrate news sentiment, fundamentals and macroeconomic variables with attention-based LSTM/Transformer models

title: Stock Market Prediction Using ML
proposed_solution: Applies machine-learning algorithms to historical stock-market data to identify patterns and predict future stock prices
limitation: Historical-data dependency may reduce accuracy when market behaviour changes significantly.
suggestion: Develop adaptive ensemble models using technical, fundamental, sentiment and real-time market features.

title: Stock Price Prediction for Stock Market Forecasting using Machine Learning
proposed_solution: Uses SVM, Random Forest and time-series analysis on historical stock data to forecast future stock prices, evaluating performance using MAPE and RMSE
limitation: Historical patterns may not reliably represent future market behaviour, especially during highly volatile periods.
suggestion: Use hybrid ML/deep-learning models, walk-forward validation and real-time adaptive retraining

title: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Algorithms for Stock Price Prediction Using Insider Trading Data
proposed_solution: Uses machine-learning algorithms to extract useful patterns/insights from stock-market data for price prediction.
limitation: Model performance depends on data quality, selected features and changing market conditions.
suggestion: Integrate technical, fundamental, sentiment and macroeconomic features using an explainable hybrid ensemble.

title: A Stock Price Prediction Method Based on Price Trend Curves
proposed_solution: Proposes an improved KNN model that uses stock-price information from the previous N trading days instead of only one day. The data is reshaped into short-term price trends, centralized to compare similar trends, and then offset correction is applied to obtain the final predicted price. The improved KNN achieved an RMSE of 3.659835, better than traditional KNN (3.98095) and Logistic Regression (4.220875).
limitation: The model is based mainly on historical stock-price trends and does not consider other factors that can affect stock prices. The experiment uses only one stock (code 600967), with 3,702 valid data points, so the results may not generalize to other stocks or markets.
suggestion: Test the improved KNN on multiple stocks and markets. Include additional features such as trading volume, technical indicators, news and investor sentiment. Hybridizing KNN with deep-learning models could also be explored.

title: Price Wise a Deep Learning Approach to Stock Price Prediction
proposed_solution: Compares LSTM, Bi-LSTM, Stacked-LSTM, Random Forest, AdaBoost and XGBoost for stock-price prediction using AAPL historical data. The study finds Stacked-LSTM to be the best among the tested LSTM models, while AdaBoost performs well when accuracy and runtime are considered together.
limitation: Stacked-LSTM gives good prediction performance but has a relatively high runtime of 80.902 ms per sample. The study also does not investigate hybrid networks combining different models.
suggestion: Investigate hybrid models, tune different hyperparameters and explore models that can maintain prediction accuracy while reducing computational time.

title: Stock Price Prediction using Bi-directional Long-Short Term Memory based Deep Neural Network
proposed_solution: Proposes a Bi-LSTM-DNN model with AMPM regression for stock-return prediction. The predicted returns are then used to construct an investment portfolio. The model was evaluated using NIFTY-50 data and achieved lower RMSE than the compared models.
limitation: The authors specifically mention prediction/access time as a limitation, and the non-stationary nature of stock data can further affect the process. The model was evaluated mainly using NIFTY-50 data, limiting evidence of generalization across markets.
suggestion: Test the model on additional stock markets and different categories of stocks. Improve computational efficiency and investigate whether the method remains effective under different market conditions.

title: Stock Prediction Using Dual Analysis of Candlestick Chart Pattern
proposed_solution: Proposes stock-price prediction using statistical data and candlestick chart patterns. Instead of considering only individual price values, the approach analyzes chart patterns and historical price movements to forecast trends for approximately 3–4 days.
limitation: The approach mainly focuses on historical price/candlestick information and therefore may miss important factors such as news, investor sentiment, economic conditions and unexpected market events. Short prediction horizons also limit its applicability for longer-term forecasting.
suggestion: Combine candlestick patterns with technical indicators, news sentiment, fundamental data and ML/deep-learning models. Test the method on different stocks, markets and longer periods to verify its robustness.

title: Time Series Forecasting in Financial Market: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) Approach for Stock Price Prediction
proposed_solution: Uses LSTM networks with technical indicators and historical stock data. It investigates different numbers of historical years, previous days, train/validation/test splits, LSTM layers and units. The study finds that careful hyperparameter selection significantly affects performance.
limitation: Performance differs significantly between companies. For example, the reported MAPE values are much higher for some stocks than others. The study mainly relies on historical prices and technical indicators, which may not capture sudden events or external market factors.
suggestion: Use news sentiment, macroeconomic indicators and other external factors along with technical indicators. Further optimize LSTM architecture and hyperparameters and investigate hybrid/advanced deep-learning models.

title: LSTM Based Stock Price Prediction on Daily Charts
proposed_solution: Uses an LSTM model to predict the next-day closing price of Reliance, TCS and ITC. It combines historical stock prices, trading volume and fundamental ratios such as PE, PB and PS. The model is evaluated using MSE, RMSE and MAPE.
limitation: The dataset covers only three companies and a relatively limited one-year period (March 2022–March 2023). Therefore, the findings may not generalize to different companies or different market conditions. The model also depends mainly on historical/fundamental data and does not incorporate real-time news or social-media sentiment.
suggestion: Increase the dataset size and include more companies and longer time periods. Add news/social-media sentiment, macroeconomic factors and technical indicators. Compare LSTM with GRU, Bi-LSTM, Transformer and hybrid models.

title: Stock Price Prediction with Fine Tuning of Support Vector Machine Using Sea Lion Optimization
proposed_solution: Proposes a hybrid SLnO-SVM model. The Sea Lion Optimization algorithm automatically optimizes SVM hyperparameters such as kernel, regularization parameter and kernel coefficient. VADER sentiment analysis is used to extract sentiment from financial news, which is combined with Nifty 50 historical data.
limitation: The study mainly uses Nifty 50 data and a specific historical period, so its generalization to other markets/stocks is not fully established. The authors also identify the need for larger datasets.
suggestion: Test the model on larger datasets and different markets/stocks. Combine SLnO with ensemble methods to improve prediction performance and robustness.

title: Stock Market Price Prediction Using Machine Learning
proposed_solution: Uses historical stock prices and trading volume with data preprocessing, feature engineering and ML models such as Logistic Regression, Linear Discriminant Analysis, Decision Tree and Random Forest. The paper also discusses using news/sentiment information and feature-selection techniques.
limitation: Stock prices are highly volatile and affected by many external factors, so the model cannot guarantee accurate predictions. The reported performance also varies considerably between models; for example, Logistic Regression gives only about 51.5% accuracy, showing that some traditional ML approaches are not reliable for this problem.
suggestion: Use larger and more diverse datasets, combine historical data with news and social-media sentiment, improve feature selection, and compare more advanced ML/deep-learning models.

title: Stock Price Prediction by Using Machine Learning Techniques: A Study of TCS Ltd
proposed_solution: Predicts the daily high price of TCS using 15 years of historical data. It compares MLR, SVM with different kernels, MLP and XGBoost. Multiple Linear Regression performs best among the tested models, with MAE = 11.57 and RMSE = 14.69.
limitation: The study focuses on only TCS Ltd. and uses mainly open, low and close prices for predicting the high price. Important external factors such as news, sentiment, macroeconomic conditions and broader market movements are not incorporated.
suggestion: Use more companies and larger/more diverse datasets. Include trading volume, technical indicators, news sentiment and macroeconomic factors. Compare the existing models with newer deep-learning and hybrid approaches.

title: A Comparison of Stock Price Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques
proposed_solution: Compares different machine-learning approaches for predicting Tesla's stock closing price. The study considers models such as Linear Regression, Polynomial Regression, XGBoost, ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM and Random Forest, and evaluates their prediction errors using measures such as MSE, RMSE and MAE. The study reports Random Forest as a high-performing model for Tesla closing-price prediction.
limitation: The study is focused on Tesla, so the results cannot automatically be generalized to other companies or markets. The approach mainly uses historical stock information and therefore may not fully capture sudden changes caused by news, economic conditions or investor sentiment.
suggestion: Use larger datasets covering multiple companies and market conditions. Include external factors such as financial news, social-media sentiment and macroeconomic indicators. More advanced deep-learning and hybrid models can also be compared.

title: Prediction of Stock Prices using LSTM Networks
proposed_solution: Proposes an LSTM-based stock-price prediction approach. LSTM is used because it can learn long-term dependencies in sequential stock data better than traditional RNNs. The paper focuses on using historical stock information to learn hidden patterns and predict future prices.
limitation: Stock prices are affected by many external factors, including earnings, government policies, news, currency fluctuations and geopolitical events. A model based primarily on historical data may therefore struggle during sudden market changes. The paper also discusses the limitations of traditional approaches when dealing with the complex and nonlinear nature of financial data.
suggestion: Increase the amount and variety of training data and include external information such as news, sentiment and economic indicators. Compare LSTM with Bi-LSTM, GRU, Transformers and hybrid models to improve prediction performance.

title: Stock Market Prediction using LSTM RNN ML
proposed_solution: Compares Simple RNN and LSTM for stock prediction, particularly for Tesla. The study uses previous stock-price information and demonstrates the ability of LSTM/RNN models to capture temporal dependencies. It also proposes future work involving feature engineering, ensemble models, hyperparameter tuning, attention/Transformer models and transfer learning.
limitation: Stock prices are influenced by many unknown factors, which makes prediction difficult. The existing approach does not sufficiently incorporate external information such as macroeconomic factors, news and social-media trends.
suggestion: Add macroeconomic indicators, news and social-media sentiment, use ensemble methods, perform hyperparameter optimization, and explore attention/Transformer, interpretable and transfer-learning models. Real-time prediction and risk assessment can also be incorporated.

title: Stock Price Prediction Using Transformers
proposed_solution: Proposes a Transformer-based stock-price prediction model using self-attention and multi-head attention to capture long-range dependencies in financial time-series data. It uses daily/weekly stock information such as Open, High, Low, Close and Volume, and uses differential features to predict changes in closing prices. The model uses multiple Transformer encoder blocks followed by an MLP. The paper reports strong prediction performance and uses data from 100 NYSE stocks over two years in its final evaluation.
limitation: The model performs well on normal market patterns but struggles with high-volatility shocks. The authors also state that the predictions should not be treated as strict buy/sell signals.
suggestion: Develop multimodal Transformers combining stock data with news, social-media sentiment and macroeconomic reports. The authors also suggest regime-aware/temporal modeling, Bayesian Transformers for uncertainty estimation, reinforcement learning for portfolio optimization, transfer learning and fundamental analysis.
